problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable, globally lower-bounded objective F on R^d. Nonconvex objectives and components are permitted. The initial gap satisfies F(x0) − lower ≤ Δ.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: F(x) = (1/n) Σ_i f_i(x), with n ≥ 1 components distributed across n workers.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Gradient evaluations return exact derivatives without stochastic noise; the system seed has a Dirac law.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: Worker i evaluates ∇f_i(x) at a requested point in time h_i > 0. Each worker has at most one pending computation, which can be aborted. The server has no computation oracle.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is Euclidean R^d, with d ≥ 1.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public parameters include n, d, x0, h_i, l, b, L, Lhat, Δ, G, and ε; component functions are the hidden instance. Here L,Lhat,ε > 0 and Δ,G ≥ 0. Smoothness requires ||∇F(x)−∇F(y)|| ≤ L||x−y|| and (1/n)Σ_i ||∇f_i(x)−∇f_i(y)||² ≤ Lhat²||x−y||². Only initial component gradients are bounded: ||∇f_i(x0)|| ≤ G. Communication uses a star with concurrent independent directed links and one pending message per link. Server-to-worker messages take zero time; a worker uplink carrying m payload bits takes l+b(m+64), including the mandatory 64-bit header, where l,b ≥ 0. Budgets measure elapsed time and algorithms receive 64-bit clock readings.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DistributedFreeBroadcastSmoothNonconvex.lean: Params, communication, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StarNetwork.lean: communication; LongTails/TemplateDistributed.lean: Time, clockBits, Algorithm, step, TimedConvergence.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm_squared
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output X with integrable squared Euclidean gradient norm satisfying E[||∇F(X)||²] ≤ ε². No particular iterate-selection rule is required.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Stationarity is required in expectation under the execution law. Algorithmic randomization is permitted despite the deterministic gradient oracle.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The smooth nonconvex finite-sum objective is standard, but the elapsed-time formulation combines heterogeneous computation times, free server broadcasts, finite-bit uplinks with latency and headers, and finite clock readings.
